title: A chain build plans its first draft in three parts at once, still with the visual review
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: The chain's planner run is started without --parallel-pages (one conversation), with the visual review, without the whole kit in its first message (parts measured slower or no faster and worse on dev, lat19 and lat20).

tests: the chain's planner run plans its first draft in one conversation, with the visual review, reading the kit by tools
